title: Spicy Spanish Courgette Fritters
description: Crispy courgette fritters with a spicy kick, inspired by French cuisine.
instructions: Preheat the oil to 180°C (350°F) for deep-frying.
In a bowl, combine grated courgette, flour, eggs, parsley, garlic powder, paprika, and salt. Mix until a dough forms.
Divide the dough into 8 equal portions and shape each into a patty.
Heat a non-stick pan with a small amount of oil over medium heat. Fry the patties until golden brown on both sides.
Increase the heat to high and deep-fry the patties for 2-3 minutes on each side, until crispy.
Drain the fritters on paper towels and sprinkle with crispy fried onions.
